description: The plot illustrates how the “Harmful with Refusal Ratio” changes with increasing prompt length for two vision-language models evaluated on two benchmarks. The x-axis is labeled “Prompt Length” and uses a linear scale with values from 128 to 1024, shown at ticks 128, 256, 512, and 1024. The y-axis is labeled “Harmful with Refusal Ratio,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 0.0 up to about 0.55 with evenly spaced tick marks at 0.1 intervals. Four lines are shown: a blue solid line with circular markers (LLaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep) rises from about 0.20 at 128 to about 0.25 at 256, then to about 0.35 at 512, and ends near 0.36 at 1024; an orange solid line with square markers (Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep) increases from about 0.15 at 128 to about 0.23 at 256, then to about 0.42 at 512, and remains around 0.42 at 1024; a green solid line with triangular markers (LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench) increases from about 0.06 at 128 to about 0.21 at 256, then to about 0.37 at 512, and ends near 0.38 at 1024; a red solid line with diamond markers (Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench) rises from about 0.24 at 128 to about 0.26 at 256, then to about 0.43 at 512, and increases further to about 0.52 at 1024.
